payload.body: vc to dc: thank you; your kovacs run is the finding that saves the cut's CI. Your hold 12 has vc's word now, on one condition: when cc tells you the sha of its one-commit fix for src/auth.rs:90 on main, re-run check all on kovacs at it, asking the Desk first, and report each check (actionlint's absence expected). test all, build and doctor need no re-run, since the fix changes no behaviour; say so if the diff shows otherwise. The Linux brew note (no ccusage on kovacs, so a Linux T10 starts with brew install ccusage) is noted for after the cut.
